Introducing Saved Views, a new way to organize how your team sees work. Starting today, Saved Views is available to everyone on a paid plan, at no extra cost. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now save your favorite configurations and return to them instantly.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, assignee, due date, or anything else that matters to your workflow. Once you've built a view you like, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same setup, no more repeating instructions or re-creating filters for teammates.

Saved Views is included automatically in every paid plan, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. Just log in and start organizing your lists the way you want.

We think this small change will save your team real time every single day.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
